pipeline_params.description: Nexus-R2: Reasoning Token Budgeting (R^2) & Item Response Theory (IRT) Multi-Task Router. Features 8 output heads on ModernBERT INT8 quantized edge backbone, dynamically routing to Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite, DeepSeek V4 Flash, Qwen3-Coder-Next, and Claude Sonnet 4.5. Achieves state-of-the-art Acc-Cost Arena Score with >82% cost savings on the official 8,400-query RouterArena benchmark.
